criterion: 設計表明列模組責任、共同契約與內部可變部分；故意讓呼叫端按私有演算法分支或讀取私有狀態時能指出違規；宣稱可替換的實作通過共同契約案例，未知或缺少證據不得宣稱符合。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed rule/design contract case. Compliant example: Two collision implementations satisfy the same Process input/result contract; private thresholds stay internal. Required finding for the counterexample: The caller branches on a private algorithm flag or obtains private mutable state: MOD-CONTRACT-001/STATE-003 failure.
limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
